description.value: Bucky's is an artisan hearth-style pizzeria serving hand-tossed and thin-crust pizzas from a large menu of specialty pies and build-your-own options. Located near the South Surrey/White Rock border, it offers counter pickup as well as delivery through Uber Eats, Skip the Dishes, and DoorDash. A touring cyclist fueling up for the road would find a broad menu including gluten-free crust and a dedicated veggie option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active pizza restaurant at 15562 - 24th Ave, White Rock BC, with phone (604) 541-1010; the OSM record lists the city as Surrey, which conflicts with the website's consistent use of White Rock. The website confirms pickup/takeout and gluten-free options but contains no mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms, leaving all required cycling criteria unverified.
concerns: Address city mismatch: OSM lists 'Surrey' but website consistently states 'White Rock, BC' — used website value.
Name mismatch: OSM name is 'Bucky's West Coast Pizzeria' but website uses 'Bucky's Pizzeria' / 'Buckys Pizzeria' throughout.
OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is active and offers cyclist-relevant takeout/GF food, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence. An on-site visit or direct contact is needed before inclusion.
